objects.description: During [SharePoint ToolShell Exploitation](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0058), threat actors, including Storm-2603, modified group policy to enable ransomware distribution.(Citation: Microsoft SharePoint Exploit JUL 2025)
objects.description_fa: در طول [SharePoint ToolShell Exploitation](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0058)، عوامل تهدید، از جمله Storm-2603، خط‌مشی گروه را برای فعال کردن توزیع باج‌افزار تغییر دادند.(Citation: Microsoft SharePoint Exploit JUL 2025)
